title: PeerReview
description: Output of Phase 4. The dispatched panel roles review the diff (all six at architectural/trivial tier; ba+dev+qa+secops plus surface-conditional dba/devops at standard tier, per status.json panel_roles). Orchestrator merges the per-role shards and computes final_verdict. Only dispatched roles appear as keys; an absent role key means trimmed-by-tier, never a missing review. APPROVE_WITH_NOTES is canonical; APPROVE_WITH_NITS is a legacy alias kept valid for archived runs.

blockers.description: Collected from all REQUEST_CHANGES blocks. Must be cleared before merge.

verdict.description: REQUEST_REFACTOR is QA-only (testability). VETO is SecOps-only.

severity.description: This schema is the single source of truth for concern severity. The canonical panel vocabulary is blocker|major|nit (DBA/DevOps/Design emit these); SecOps's CVE-style critical|high|medium|low|info is accepted alongside it so a SecOps concern (e.g. severity 'low') validates cleanly. Distinct from the knowledge_drift_claims severity field.

notes.description: Free-text reasoning. String preferred; an array of strings is accepted (agents emit both in practice).

knowledge_drift_claims.description: Optional staleness claims for the Librarian, recorded INSIDE the block (never as a sibling key beside it).
